title: Inbox
description: Direct messages to your accounts, read live from Instagram and TikTok. Reply by hand when an automation is not enough.
noText: A message without text (a photo, a sticker or a shared post).

states.loadFailedDescription: The platform did not answer. Nothing was changed; try again in a moment.

noChannels.title: Connect an account first
noChannels.description: The inbox shows the direct messages of a connected account.

reauth.title: @{username} needs reconnecting
reauth.description: The platform stopped accepting this account's access, so its messages cannot be read. An admin can reconnect it from the channels page.

empty.title: No conversations yet
empty.description: When someone sends @{username} a direct message, or an automation writes to them, the conversation appears here.

noMessages: No messages in this conversation yet.

composer.label: Reply to {name}
composer.hint: You can reply for a while after the person's last message: 24 hours on Instagram, 48 on TikTok.
composer.windowClosed: {name} wrote too long ago, so the platform does not allow a reply now. You can answer as soon as they write to you again.
